notes: Clearer everywhere: one name per action, labelled New / Open / Import, plain tab names (Save values, Load test, Notes)
Team sync without git jargon: one status, one-click Sync with team, guided sharing, side-by-side conflict choices
Accessibility: readable contrast, full keyboard use, screen reader announcements, Windows High Contrast support
Windows: one recommended installer with Start menu and desktop shortcuts, plus a Portable version
